Advisor assignment 17:52: while the docs-stack reviews finish, take TASK-HOME-117 (fasttrack, approved): make `aida agent list` the canonical subcommand, keep `ls` and `status` as aliases, update help/docs/template masters (then make sync-templates), and add a test that `aida agent ls` still works. Full acceptance is in the spec. Claim it, use your own worktree, run make check-ci-fast, and open one PR via /aida-pr.

Docs stack: 3097 approved; 3096 needs changes; 3098-3103 still in review. I will send ONE bundled ruling for the whole stack when all eight verdicts are in, so do not touch the stack branches until then.
subject: TASK-HOME-117 assignment + docs stack status
